channel.title: Adeeb Noor — Research Updates
channel.description: Curated recent research and public scholarly updates by Adeeb Noor.

item.title: Performance equivalence does not imply action equivalence in AI systems
item.description: Manuscript · work in progress. Ongoing research on the gap between maintained aggregate performance and changed system actions: which evidence is used, what is selected, and which changes an explicit objective requires. This is a work in progress, not a published or accepted article.

item.title: From Answer Production to Defensible Engineering Judgment in AI-Containing Systems: The iSCARB Framework and a Nine-Chapter Software Engineering Implementation
item.description: Preprint · not peer reviewed. A framework and nine-chapter implementation for human-owned engineering judgment in systems containing AI. It combines evidence, explicit limits, changed conditions and justified revision; learning effectiveness remains an evaluation question.

item.title: Context-aware AI assistance reduces diagnostic error in chest X-ray interpretation
item.description: Peer-reviewed article. With Redhwan Nour, this study evaluates selective, context-aware AI assistance for chest X-ray interpretation rather than assuming AI should always be shown.

item.title: Ontology-Enhanced Deep Learning for Mechanistic Prediction of Drug-Drug Interactions: A Clinically Interpretable Framework
item.description: Peer-reviewed article. A clinically interpretable DDI framework combining ontology-based embeddings with deep learning to predict pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamic interaction mechanisms.

item.title: BioUNER: A Benchmark Dataset for Clinical Urdu Named Entity Recognition
item.description: Preprint · benchmark dataset. A biomedical Urdu named-entity recognition benchmark built from 153K annotated tokens and evaluated with classical, deep-learning and multilingual transformer baselines.

item.title: Optimizing electric vehicle energy consumption prediction through machine learning and ensemble approaches
item.description: Peer-reviewed article. A machine-learning study of EV energy-consumption prediction using real-world data, hyperparameter optimization and a stacking ensemble.

item.title: FCIT announces Adeeb Noor's promotion to Full Professor
item.description: Institutional announcement. The Faculty of Computing and Information Technology publicly announced the Scientific Council decision promoting Adeeb Noor to Full Professor in the Information Technology Department.
